title: 汇万总春之庙 Huiwan Zongchun zhi Miao
subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: A plain box on the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class. It will be updated as the research goes on.
rows: platform 0.7 m, eave 4.4 m, ridge 7.01 m above the ground
hip-and-gable 歇山, rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 濂溪乐处
evidence.excerpt_zh: 濓溪樂處之南為彚萬總春之廟正殿為蕃育羣芳五楹殿東北樓為香逺益清樓西為樂天和為味真書屋又西為池水共心月同明廟東沿山徑出為普濟橋（圓明園册）臣等謹按彚萬總春之廟以祀花神殿樓諸額皆皇上御書池水共心月同明額世宗御書
evidence.summary: South of 濓溪樂處: the flower-spirit temple 彚萬總春之廟, with the five-bay 蕃育羣芳, 香逺益清, 樂天和, 味真書屋, 池水共心月同明 and the 普濟橋.

evidence.title: 《日下舊聞考》 on 彙萬總春之廟, 花神庙
evidence.excerpt_zh: 彚萬總春之廟以祀花神
evidence.summary: The plan's 花神庙 is the 汇万总春之庙 of the text, for the flower god.

evidence.title: 汇万总春之庙
evidence.locator: v3 p.153, under 汇万总春之庙; source ref 1-320
evidence.excerpt_zh: 庙制仿西湖，云楣天藻敷。长欣春浩荡，永沐泽涵濡。应候光风转，含滋好雨符。东皇施妙术，锦绣满京都。
evidence.summary: Poem 汇万总春之庙 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1798, filed by the editors under 汇万总春之庙.

evidence.title: Scene 23, 濂溪乐处 Lianxi Lechu
evidence.excerpt_other: But the map does locate a stone foundation to represent a boat which stood in the water near the south shore of the lake. The Temple of the Goddess of Flowers stood on the narrow strip of land south of the lake and faced southward upon a canal.
evidence.summary: Island buildings with a long covered porch on piles, a hollow square over the lotus pond; two small waterfalls; hills behind. The Official Map does not show the porch or the open pavilion south of the island, probably removed by then, but shows a stone boat foundation near the south shore. 花神庙 on the strip south of the lake, facing a canal.

evidence.title: 贾珺, 圆明三园中的祀庙祠宇建筑探析, 故宫博物院院刊 2012(3)
evidence.summary: A survey of the 33 shrines of the three gardens, with dates and forms: ancestor halls, flower god and dragon king temples, 河神庙, 关帝庙. The first thing to read for small temples with little else. Assigned here by type, not checked per temple.

evidence.title: 花神庙: 圆明园莳花碑 (S47 section 4)
evidence.summary: A rubbing of the 莳花碑 of 1745, now at Peking University, once stood in this temple; three officials in charge of the garden flowers raised it, though S47 dates the main building to 1769: the two dates are not reconciled.

evidence.title: 贾珺 on 花神庙
evidence.summary: Independent court, built 1769: five-bay gate hall, five-bay main hall 蕃育群芳, three-bay side halls. Painted rockwork and flower scenery were made inside the gate; a peony frame stood inside. Form loosely follows the temple at West Lake.

evidence.title: 圆明园汇万总春之庙与江南民间的花神信仰
evidence.summary: Sets the flower god temple 汇万总春之庙 beside the Jiangnan cult, chiefly the West Lake 花神庙 湖山春社 of 1731 built by 李卫, and the 竹素园 of 1732 next to it.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 汇万总春之庙
evidence.summary: The flower-god temple garden on the south shore of 濂溪乐处, from early Qianlong: five-bay 蕃育群芳, tower with plaques 涵虚朗鉴 and 香远益清, 乐天和, 味真书屋, an open hall 池水共心月同明, and the boat-shaped 宝莲航.

evidence.title: 《国家图书馆藏样式雷图档·圆明园卷初编》: 濂溪乐处（汇万总春之庙附）
evidence.date: mostly 道光, 咸丰, 同治 per the publisher
evidence.locator: 初编 目录: 濂溪乐处（汇万总春之庙附）, pp.300-320
evidence.summary: The printed facsimile of the National Library of China's Yangshi Lei sheets has a section on this place at pp.300-320 (21 pages, section length worked out from the next heading); sheet titles and numbers are in the volume, ordered from a library.

evidence.title: 圆明园新证, 端木泓: dated additions shown on plan 1704
evidence.summary: Tables of when things were added, drawn from archives to date the plan's layers: 藻园 1752, 廓然大公 eight views 1754, 春雨轩 1755, 藏密楼 1758, 多稼轩 ten views 1759, 紫碧山房 1760, 安澜园 and 澄练楼 1763, 若帆之阁 1764, 汇万总春之庙 1769, 文源阁 1775, 法源楼 1779; after: 兰亭八柱 1779, 知过堂 1782, 课农轩 1816, 涵月楼 1827. The most useful single dating table found.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 花神庙, 4x1 cells.
